name.label: Store name
name.help: The name customers see. Your own data: it never goes to another installation.

locale.label: Language and number format
locale.help: A language tag such as bn-BD or en-GB. Dates and numbers are written in this language.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.help: Where the shop's day starts and ends, for example Asia/Dhaka.

currency.label: Currency
currency.help: Three-letter currency code, for example BDT.

stagingHost.label: Preview site address
stagingHost.help: Shown for information only. The server configuration decides the real address.

ownerData.settingReason: The owner's own data: kept out of every export to a new installation.
